sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Figma
  • 한 줄 정체성: 4색 도형이 협업하는, 캔버스를 모든 디자이너가 공유하는 디자인 도구의 표준
  • 공식 디자인 철학: "The future of design is collaborative — multiplayer, in the browser, for everyone"
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: Figma 4색 로고 (오렌지 #F24E1E, 퍼플 #A259FF, 블루 #1ABCFE, 그린 #0ACF83) + Inter 본문 + Multiplayer cursor 컬러풀 톤
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 협업, 컬러풀, 도구적
  • 무드 설명: 조용한 grayscale 캔버스에 4색 액센트가 동시다발적으로 흐른다. 마케팅은 컬러풀하고 활기차며, 도구 UI는 차분한 워크스페이스 톤이다.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀 (도구) + 컬러풀 craft (마케팅)
  • 밀도(Density): Compact — 디자인 도구 패널 위주
  • 모서리 성향: Soft (4~6px 도구 / 12~16px 마케팅 카드)
  • 평면성: Subtle — 도구는 flat, 마케팅은 그라데이션 + 그림자
sections.③:
:root {
  /* Primary - Figma Blue (UI selection 컬러) */
  --color-primary-50:  #E5F4FF;
  --color-primary-100: #CCE9FE;
  --color-primary-200: #99D3FE;
  --color-primary-300: #66BCFD;
  --color-primary-400: #33A6FD;
  --color-primary-500: #0D99FF;  /* Figma UI selection blue */
  --color-primary-600: #0784D9;
  --color-primary-700: #0669AB;
  --color-primary-800: #054E80;
  --color-primary-900: #033255;

  /* Secondary - Figma 4색 액센트 */
  --color-figma-orange: #F24E1E;
  --color-figma-purple: #A259FF;
  --color-figma-cyan:   #1ABCFE;
  --color-figma-green:  #0ACF83;
  --color-secondary-500: var(--color-figma-purple);

  /* Neutral */
  --color-neutral-0:    #FFFFFF;
  --color-neutral-50:   #F5F5F5;
  --color-neutral-100:  #E6E6E6;
  --color-neutral-200:  #D9D9D9;
  --color-neutral-300:  #B3B3B3;
  --color-neutral-500:  #757575;
  --color-neutral-700:  #4D4D4D;
  --color-neutral-800:  #2C2C2C;
  --color-neutral-900:  #1E1E1E;
  --color-neutral-1000: #000000;

  /* Semantic */
  --color-success-bg: #DCF7E5;
  --color-success-fg: #14AE5C;
  --color-warning-bg: #FFF3D2;
  --color-warning-fg: #E08C00;
  --color-error-bg:   #FCE0DE;
  --color-error-fg:   #F24822;
  --color-info-bg:    #E5F4FF;
  --color-info-fg:    #0D99FF;

  /* Surface */
  --bg-base:     #FFFFFF;
  --bg-subtle:   #F5F5F5;
  --bg-elevated: #FFFFFF;
  --bg-overlay:  rgba(0,0,0,0.40);

  /* Text */
  --text-primary:    #1E1E1E;
  --text-secondary:  #757575;
  --text-tertiary:   #B3B3B3;
  --text-on-primary: #FFFFFF;
  --text-disabled:   #B3B3B3;

  /* Border */
  --border-default: #E6E6E6;
  --border-subtle:  #F0F0F0;
  --border-strong:  #B3B3B3;
  --border-focus:   #0D99FF;
}

[data-theme="dark"] {
  /* Figma 도구 다크 */
  --bg-base: #2C2C2C;
  --bg-subtle: #1E1E1E;
  --bg-elevated: #383838;
  --text-primary: #FFFFFF;
  --text-secondary: #B3B3B3;
  --border-default: #444444;
}
sections.④:
• 폰트 페어링:
    • 영문: Inter (OFL) / Whyte (Figma 마케팅 일부) — 폴백 -apple-system
    • 한글: Pretendard (OFL) / Apple SD Gothic Neo
    • 모노: ui-monospace, "Roboto Mono"
  • 위계:
    • Display: 64px / 600 / 1.05 / -0.03em (마케팅)
    • H1: 44px / 600 / 1.1 / -0.02em
    • H2: 28px / 600 / 1.2 / -0.015em
    • H3: 20px / 600 / 1.3 / -0.01em
    • Body Large: 16px / 400 / 1.5 / 0
    • Body: 14px / 400 / 1.43 / 0
    • Body Small: 12px / 400 / 1.33 / 0
    • Caption: 11px / 500 / 1.27 / 0.04em (도구 UI 라벨)
sections.⑤:
• Base unit: 4px
  • 토큰: ``css --space-xs: 4px; --space-sm: 8px; --space-md: 12px; /* 도구 패널 */ --space-lg: 16px; --space-xl: 24px; --space-2xl: 48px; --space-3xl: 80px; ``
  • Container: max-width 1280px (마케팅), 좌우 패딩 24px
sections.⑦:
--shadow-none: none;
--shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
--shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);                 /* popover */
--shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);                 /* modal */
--shadow-xl: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.16);
sections.⑧:
• 스타일: Outline (도구 UI) + Filled (마케팅)
  • Stroke 굵기: 1.5px
  • 모서리 처리: Round
  • 추천 라이브러리: Figma Icons (Inside Figma) / Lucide (호환)
sections.⑨:
Button

.btn {
  font: 500 12px/1 "Inter", "Pretendard", sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 0 12px;
  height: 32px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: background 100ms ease;
}
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-600); }
.btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-primary-700); }
.btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--color-neutral-100); color: var(--text-disabled); }

.btn-secondary { background: var(--bg-base); color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--border-default); }
.btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--text-primary); }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); border-color: transparent; }
.btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-neutral-100); }
.btn-danger { background: var(--color-error-fg); color: #fff; }

Input

.input {
  background: var(--bg-base);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 0 8px;
  height: 32px;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.input:hover { border-color: var(--text-tertiary); }
.input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--border-focus);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border-focus);
}
.input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-error-fg); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-error-fg); }

Card

.card { background: var(--bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 16px; }
.card-elevated { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); border-color: transparent; }
.card-outlined { box-shadow: none; }

Badge / Tag

.tag { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.tag-solid   { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.tag-subtle  { background: var(--color-primary-50); color: var(--color-primary-700); }
.tag-outline { border: 1px solid var(--border-default); color: var(--text-primary); }
.tag-orange { background: rgba(242,78,30,0.10); color: #C53D17; }
.tag-purple { background: rgba(162,89,255,0.12); color: #6B2FCC; }
.tag-cyan   { background: rgba(26,188,254,0.12); color: #0784D9; }
.tag-green  { background: rgba(10,207,131,0.12); color: #099463; }

Navigation (Top toolbar — 도구)

.toolbar { height: 48px; background: var(--bg-base); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px; gap: 4px; }
.toolbar .icon-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--text-primary); }
.toolbar .icon-btn:hover { background: var(--color-neutral-100); }
.toolbar .icon-btn.active { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
sections.⑩:
--duration-fast: 100ms;
--duration-base: 200ms;
--duration-slow: 350ms;
--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
--ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
/* Multiplayer cursor 트레일 */
--cursor-trail: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1);
sections.⑪: 1. 도구 UI 캔버스 위에 brand 그라데이션 사용 금지 — 사용자 작업물이 주인공 2. 4색 액센트를 한 화면에 4개 모두 동시 사용 금지 (마케팅 hero 외) — 시각 노이즈 3. 도구 패널 폰트 14px 이상 사용 금지 — 12/11px가 표준 4. cursor 색을 brand 색으로 강제 매핑 금지 — multiplayer 컬러풀 톤 보존 5. 모달 내부 모달 중첩 금지 — drawer 분리

<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; font-family: "Inter", "Pretendard", -apple-system, sans-serif; color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-subtle); }
  .figma-hero { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 72px 24px 32px; }
  .hero-copy { max-width: 720px; margin-bottom: 36px; }
  .eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-primary-600); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .hero-copy h1 { margin: 14px 0 16px; font-size: clamp(40px,6vw,72px); line-height: .98; letter-spacing: -.045em; font-weight: 600; }
  .hero-copy p { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 0 24px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.55; }
  .hero-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
  .hero-actions .btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; }
  .figma-editor { height: 540px; display: grid; grid-template-rows: 48px 1fr; overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl); }
  .editor-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--bg-base); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); font-size: 12px; }
  .figma-mark { width: 14px; height: 21px; flex: none; }
  .file-name { font-weight: 600; }
  .file-state { color: var(--text-tertiary); }
  .presence { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; }
  .avatar { width: 24px; height: 24px; margin-left: -5px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 2px solid var(--bg-base); border-radius: 50%; color: #fff; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; }
  .share { margin-left: 10px; }
  .editor-body { min-height: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 190px 1fr 220px; }
  .panel { padding: 14px 10px; background: var(--bg-base); font-size: 11px; }
  .panel.left { border-right: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
  .panel.right { border-left: 1px solid var(--border-default); }
  .panel-title { margin: 2px 0 10px; font-weight: 600; }
  .panel-tabs { display: flex; gap: 14px; padding: 0 4px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
  .panel-tabs .active { color: var(--color-primary-500); font-weight: 600; }
  .layer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .layer.active { background: var(--color-primary-50); color: var(--color-primary-700); }
  .prop-section { padding: 12px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }
  .prop-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600; }
  .prop-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px; }
  .prop { padding: 8px; background: var(--bg-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .canvas { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background-color: var(--bg-subtle); background-image: radial-gradient(var(--border-default) .8px,transparent .8px); background-size: 16px 16px; }
  .artboard { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 48%; width: 250px; height: 350px; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); padding: 24px; background: var(--bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--color-primary-500); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-primary-500),var(--shadow-md); }
  .handle { position: absolute; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--color-primary-500); }
  .handle.tl { left: -4px; top: -4px; } .handle.br { right: -4px; bottom: -4px; }
  .screen-title { width: 94px; height: 13px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--text-primary); }
  .visual { height: 108px; margin-bottom: 18px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: linear-gradient(135deg,var(--color-figma-purple),var(--color-figma-cyan)); position: relative; }
  .visual::after { content:""; position:absolute; width:62px; height:62px; right:20px; top:20px; border:12px solid rgba(255,255,255,.82); border-radius:50%; }
  .copy-line { height: 8px; margin: 7px 0; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--border-default); }
  .copy-line.strong { width: 72%; background: var(--text-primary); }
  .choice-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin: 18px 0; }
  .choice { height: 42px; background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  .artboard .btn-primary { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }
  .cursor { position: absolute; z-index: 5; color: var(--cursor-color); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 var(--bg-base)); }
  .cursor::after { content:attr(data-name); display:block; width:max-content; margin: 1px 0 0 9px; padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--cursor-color); color:#fff; font-size: 9px; filter:none; }
  .cursor.mina { --cursor-color:var(--color-figma-orange); left: 60%; top: 17%; }
  .cursor.joon { --cursor-color:var(--color-figma-purple); left: 28%; top: 58%; transform: rotate(-16deg); }
  .tool-dock { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 14px; z-index: 4; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; gap: 3px; padding: 5px; background: var(--bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-md); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
  .tool { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 13px; }
  .tool.active { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: var(--text-on-primary); }
  .features { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px 24px 80px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 16px; }
  .feature-card { min-height: 210px; padding: 24px; background: var(--bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
  .feature-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 28px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; }
  .feature-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 18px; }
  .feature-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; }
  @media (max-width:760px) { .editor-body { grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr; } .panel.right { display:none; } .features { grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
</style>
